_comment: The build popup (wire id 25), work order 180 C. Geometry and state: screens/build_queue/bqwire.py; drawing and marks: bqdraw.py. Each mark is held by check 090q and named in dev:v3_projektstatus.md.

words._note: DEVIATION `button_words`: the six buttons carry their words in COLBLDG.LBX art (colbldg.cpp:346-364); HD draws them as HUD buttons with the words in code.

marks.deviation_ship_row_dim: NARROWED, work order 208 B8. A design LARGE or bigger is dimmed while the colony has no star base, star fortress or battlestation (colbldg.cpp:714-721, bqdraw.design_needs_base), as in the original. Since work order 437 also dimmed: what Colony_Can_Build_Product refuses (colbldg.cpp:726-729; core.shipbuildrule: range, speed, tech, type, size; bqdraw.design_cannot_build). Still not dimmed: a special ship whose Auto_Design_Type is 0 (:730-745, OMISSION ship_row_special). OMISSION config_minimum_orbital_base_ship_class: the size from which a base is needed is the engine's config default.
marks.deviation_hd_font: Text in the HD font at a size from the native line pitch, fitted to the original's width (the Leaders screen's rule).
marks.omission_delete_hint: The original prints 'delete %s' over the queue row ITS pointer is on (colbldg.cpp:714-750); HD's pointer is not the game's, and the hint is not drawn.
marks.hd_extension_summary_follows_hd_pointer: The summary shows the item under HD's pointer, where the original's follows its own (_scanned_prod, colbldg.cpp:825); hovering sends nothing.
marks.deviation_one_edge: Work order 226 D: a list column is its shell panel, the original's inner box round the list is not drawn again inside it; the picture, summary and description boxes are cells of the middle panel (the shell's field); the lists' words stand at the shell's inset from the panel's inner line (Data's screenshot of 9 October 2026: no inset, two edges).
marks.hd_extension_build_colours: Data's mockup of 1 November 2026: the product's name and the row of the chosen product (the one under the pointer, else the queue's first) in orange, the summary's lines gold, a design's table labels and heads orange over white values, its weapons and specials light grey two to a line, the other list rows grey (bqcolour.py, measured off the mockup).
marks.hd_extension_build_grid_room: Data's grid picture (mod folder popups/build_grid.png) fills the picture box instead of the original's room (COLBLDG.LBX 0); the product stands in it by its own pixels (colroom.product_only). Without the file the original's room is drawn.
marks.hd_extension_build_lists_mockup: Data's mockup of 25 November 2026 (work order 432): the two lists as rows with a picture in front, the chosen row on a bar, a scroll bar and the wheel, the right list's three groups as boxes with a head (bqlist). A row stands for the game's field of the same place in the list; the click activates that field. INVENTION group_heads: the words Ships, Designs, Androids are ours.
marks.hd_extension_build_summary_mockup: Data's mockup of 25 November 2026 (work order 432): the summary's name in a large type over a rule, its numbers behind HUD glyphs in the frame colour, the glyphs in front of the buttons' words, the heading CONSTRUCTION QUEUE (INVENTION queue_heading), and the painted scene under a help text (HD EXTENSION build_list_scene, the player's popups/build_art.png) (bqmiddle).
